stories.title: Buckley dog waste bin campaign a success for councillor
stories.summary: A dog bin site in Buckley which was delayed for seven months now has somewhere for pet owners to put their poop. stories.title: Connah’s Quay swimmer Rhys Darbey wins Commonwealth Games bronze in Glasgow
stories.summary: Connah’s Quay swimmer Rhys Darbey has won a Commonwealth Games bronze medal in Glasgow after the team-mate who beat him to third place was disqualified. stories.title: Asda and Food and Drink Wales launch supplier training programme
stories.summary: Asda is to run a training programme for more than 30 Welsh food and drink suppliers alongside Food and Drink Wales, the Welsh Government’s food and drink division. stories.title: Amazon donates 30 emergency bags for people fleeing domestic abuse in north Wales
stories.summary: Thirty emergency bags for people fleeing domestic abuse are to be held at police stations across north Wales, after a donation from Amazon to North Wales Police. stories.title: Newt protection plans lodged for A55 charging station next to OK Diner
stories.summary: Great crested newts will be fenced out of land on the A55 at Ewloe before work starts on an electric vehicle charging station, under plans lodged with Flintshire County Council.
